newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM target $200-225 - Goldman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM target $200-225 - Goldman.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Laura Conigliaro initiated coverage of International Business Machines Corp with a price target of $200 to $225, with the lower target reflecting her current estimate and the stock's current multiple, and the higher end reflecting upside earnings possibilities.
-- Her current earnings estimates are $12.45 for 1997 and $14.35 for 1998.

-- Conigliaro said IBM's multiple still seems quite reasonable relative to its own growth, its peers and to the broader market but the possibilities for upside are increasing. IBM's shares were up 1-3/4 to 175-1/4.
